title: Switchback Bandana
care: Fold it flat for a pocket or tie it to a tote handle. Keep a clean one for personal use rather than wiping muddy gear with the same cloth.
Wash cool with similar colors and air dry. Let it dry fully before folding it away.
The dimensions describe this illustrated design, not a measured sample. The contour pattern is decorative, not a map. No protective performance rating is claimed.
